name: Omokage ~Ecchi na Happening!? Nandemo Dontokoi!~
original_name: オモカゲ ～えっちなハプニング!? なんでもどんとこい!～
source:
There have lately been strange rumours in the provincial city of Mihana: witness reports of girls masturbating, and girls suddenly breathing heavily. As a guy, Sei would like to see it with his own eyes, but he dismissed it as a simple urban legend. However, one day after school, he saw a girl who looked like she was masturbating by rubbing her back against a locker. He didn’t realize it at that moment, but he could sense something strange from certain places and girls. He wasn’t the only one who had the same sensations, but also his osananajimi Minato, cool senpai Gekka and cheerful kouhai Hinami. It seems that these incidents were caused by ‘omokage’, which are like spirits which possess humans and affect their mind and body until their desires have been satiated, so they decided to form the anti-omokage club to combat them.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/03/10/march-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
最近，省城米哈纳流传着奇怪的谣言：目击者称女孩正在自慰，女孩突然呼吸粗重。作为一个男人，Sei很想亲眼看到它，但他认为这只是一个简单的都市传说。然而，有一天放学后，他看到一名女孩在储物柜上蹭背，看起来像是在自慰。他当时并没有意识到，但他从某些地方和女孩身上感觉到了一些奇怪的东西。有同样感觉的人不只是他一个人，还有他的长辈凑、帅气的月花前辈和开朗的日南红孩。看来这些事件都是由‘魔影’引起的，它们就像附身在人类身上的灵魂，影响着人类的身心，直到他们的欲望得到满足，所以他们决定成立反魔影俱乐部来对抗它们。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/03/10/march-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
